More than 24 hours and no new question?

Here's another boring mechanical one.

Which Villains can play and/or put into play 4 or more cards in a single turn with no outside help? Which side of their character card would they have to be on for this to happen?

Bonus points for separating the list into the ones who can do it on the first turn of the game and the ones that can't.

posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked:
Blade can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, by chaining Hasten Dooms. Ditto for Mad Bomber Blade.

Omnitron can, on either side, but not on the first turn, by playing Terraforming in a card-rich environment. Ditto for Cosmitron, with the addition of being able to chain drones on its flip-side.

Dawn can, on either side, but not on the first turn, by a combination of Channel The Eclipses and Returns with the Dawn.

Voss can, on either side, but not on the first turn, with Forced Deployment.

Spite can, on his front side only, not on the first turn, by playing Lab Raid in a card-rich environment. Broken Vessel Spite sort of can, but it depends on your definition on outside help - if the players choose to rescue three Good Samaritans, one of them plays a Forced Entry, and then the players rescue another Samaritan, then Spite gets four plays on the environment turn.

Plague Rat can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with a Ravage or Shadowy Ambushes.

The Matriarch can. Gods, the Matriarch can...

The Chairman can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, either by Prison Break or just The Operatice and underbosses bringing out more cards.

Akash'Bhuta can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Primeval Eruption.

Apostate can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Profane Summons.

The Ennead can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Rise to Power and Atum and/or Set.

Gloomweaver can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Vast Followings. Ditto for The Rotting God.

Kismet can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Karmic Disjunction.

La Capitan can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Raiding Party.

The Dreamer can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Violent Nightmares.

Iron Legacy can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with a chain of Former Allies.

Ambuscade can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Run and Gun and Quick Stim-Patches.

Miss Information can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Diversionary Tactics.

The Vengeful Five as a whole can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, with Old Tricks - New Allies or Synergy Surge.

Friction can, on either side, potentially on the first turn of the game, primarily with Unhealthy Speed.

Proletariat can, on either side, not on the first turn of the game, with Regroup and Recover and Share In The Struggle.
